item.title: Planned Parenthood drops lawsuit against Trump administration’s Medicaid cuts
item.description: Planned Parenthood has dropped its legal challenge against the Trump administration's decision to cut off Medicaid funding to its abortion providers. Since July, the organization has been fighting a part of Trump's tax bill that they claim unfairly targeted their clinics. In December, a federal appeals court ruled the administration could continue withholding Medicaid funding. Planned Parenthood says the lawsuit is now no longer the best way to help patients.
